title: echo-agent-extension-v1
description: echo-agent SDK extension contract over stable ACP v1. Standard ACP types are owned by the official agent-client-protocol-schema artifact and are intentionally absent from this document.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/agent/create
method_catalog.summary: Construct an agent instance from a typed config; framework validates.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/agent/describe
method_catalog.summary: Capability snapshot and immutable construction facts of an agent.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/agent/close
method_catalog.summary: Release an agent; in-flight runs settle via framework semantics.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/session/create
method_catalog.summary: Create an extension session handle on an agent.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/session/load
method_catalog.summary: Resume a persisted session by framework identity.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/session/close
method_catalog.summary: Release a session handle; idempotent.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/run/start
method_catalog.summary: Start a chat/execute run; returns run handle and first event.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/run/get
method_catalog.summary: Snapshot run status, last sequence and settled terminal/receipt.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/run/wait
method_catalog.summary: Bounded wait for the single authoritative terminal.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/run/cancel
method_catalog.summary: Request cancellation; framework CAS decides the unique outcome.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/run/steer
method_catalog.summary: Mid-flight steering on supporting runs.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/run/replay
method_catalog.summary: Bounded event replay strictly after a cursor; gap-aware.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/event
method_catalog.summary: Full EventEnvelope notification for accepted framework events.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/gap
method_catalog.summary: Retention-floor breach notice with snapshot watermark.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/task/create
method_catalog.summary: Create a PlanTask in a revisioned TaskRun graph.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/task/update
method_catalog.summary: Patch a task at an expected revision (optimistic concurrency).

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/task/list
method_catalog.summary: List task identity/status/revision summaries of a TaskRun.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/task/execute
method_catalog.summary: Drive one PlanTask through the framework executor.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/task/control
method_catalog.summary: Pause/resume/cancel a task via the framework service.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/subagent/dispatch
method_catalog.summary: Dispatch a subagent execution; framework scheduler owns it.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/subagent/await
method_catalog.summary: Bounded wait for a subagent result.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/subagent/control
method_catalog.summary: Control verbs for a running subagent.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/extension/register
method_catalog.summary: Register a host-language implementation of a public trait.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/extension/unregister
method_catalog.summary: Release a registered extension; idempotent.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/extension/invoke
method_catalog.summary: Host -> SDK reverse call into a registered implementation.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/extension/cancel
method_catalog.summary: Host -> SDK cancellation notice for an in-flight invocation.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/structured_output/validate
method_catalog.summary: Validate a structured-output contract against the facade schema.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/memory/op
method_catalog.summary: Memory store operations projected verbatim until typed DTOs land.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/workflow/op
method_catalog.summary: Workflow definition/execution operations.

method_catalog.name: _echo_agent/state/op
method_catalog.summary: State/delivery/trace operations over framework stores.

WirePath.description: A local filesystem path that standard ACP UTF-8 rules cannot express losslessly (design §10.5). Exactly one physical representation is set; `display` is a human-readable convenience and never the authority.

oneOf.description: Absolute Unix path with its original bytes (base64). Preserves non-UTF-8 byte sequences.

WireUnknown.title: WireUnknown
WireUnknown.description: A typed view over an unknown additive extension value (design §18): older SDKs must observe unknown events without crashing, retaining the original type tag and a bounded payload.

WireHandle.title: WireHandle
WireHandle.description:
Opaque handle to a framework object: non-empty domain id + generation.

Ids are strings assigned by the framework authority; the SDK never interprets their content, never exposes memory addresses, and never reuses an id across kinds.

generation.description: Monotonic generation of the owning Host; incremented across restarts so pre-restart handles fail as stale instead of rebinding.

id.description: Non-empty domain identity assigned by the framework.

HandleKind.description: What kind of framework object a handle refers to. Typed kinds keep stale errors diagnosable across the wire.
